mods.name: Record Streaming
mods.author: dnlsndr
mods.summary: Keeps MASTER REC running while a streaming service plays.
mods.description:
Removes the streaming-service block from the deck's USB recorder: MASTER REC can start with a streaming track loaded, and loading one does not stop an active recording.

It hooks the recorder's startable check and its reason notification on EP147 2.00 only (ep147-9e9454e357389ece). The other checks (recording device, Bluetooth input, a track still loading) are left unchanged. No firmware bytes are included; the mod verifies the hooked code's 16-byte fingerprint before claiming it.

mods.name: Spotify Highest Quality
mods.author: dnlsndr
mods.summary: Selects the Spotify DJ SDK quality level, safely.
mods.description:
Adds a Mod Menu choice row for Spotify quality: Deck default, Fastest (0) or Default (5). Deck default leaves EP147's value untouched. The DJAudioQuality level 8 (Highest) crashed EP147 when a Spotify track was loaded, so it is not offered. The log prints the deck's own value on the first add_track call.

This is still the deck's Spotify integration; it is not Spotify Lossless/FLAC. The hardware eSDK's playback bitrate API has no lossless setting.
